jobs.occupation: Pilot Line PDK & Design Enablement Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 246-0
jobs.description:
Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) - In the network of science and industry, SAL offers research in the areas of Sensor Systems, RF Systems, Power Electronics, System Integration Technologies and Embedded Systems.

SAL - a great place to research. 1 Pilot Line PDK & Design Enablement Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 246-0 

Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

In the Position as Staff Research Engineer you are responsible for the central PDK function across SAL's technology platforms and pilot-line activities. You ensure that PDK content, models, verification flows, documentation, and release processes are consistent, traceable, and aligned with fabrication capabilities-enabling reliable design-to-fab handshakes for internal teams and open-access users (with a strong relevance for integrated photonics and related quantum/MEMS device concepts).

Your responsibilities include:

 * PDK strategy & roadmap: define and maintain a consolidated PDK roadmap (priorities, maturity targets, releases) aligned with platform and fabrication evolution.

 * PDK governance & release management: establish a structured release process (versioning, release notes, change control, qualification evidence, deprecation rules) and ensure predictable delivery for users.

 * Design-to-fab interface: act as the interface between designers and fabrication teams to align layer definitions, design rules, tolerances, process assumptions, sign-off criteria, and handover packages.

 * PDK content quality: own quality of PDK deliverables such as DRC/LVS/PEX flows (as applicable), models, corners/variability knobs, examples, and user documentation.

 * Validation & calibration: coordinate validation and calibration plans with measurement/metrology and process teams; ensure model updates are evidence-based and traceable to wafer data.

 * EDA and enablement flows: maintain compatibility with relevant EDA toolchains; provide reference flows, templates, and automation where beneficial (build/release tooling, regression checks).

 * User support & enablement: support internal teams and selected external open-access users (onboarding, requirements clarification, feedback capture) and translate user needs into backlog items.

 * Documentation & know-how management: ensure strong documentation discipline and coordinate what can be shared externally vs what must be protected, in collaboration with responsible functions.

Dein Profil

 * Strong experience (min. 8+ years) in PDK development and design enablement (verification flows, models, documentation, releases) in a semiconductor / photonics / MEMS-related environment.

 * MSc/PhD in EE, Physics, Photonics, Microsystems, or comparable.

 * Solid understanding of the design-fabrication interface and how process variability impacts models, rules, and design margins.

 * Hands-on experience with EDA ecosystems and PDK integration; scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python/TCL) are a strong plus.

 * Experience working with wafer data for model calibration/validation and structured change control.

 * Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate across a matrix organization (design, process teams, metrology, external users).

 * Fluent English; German is a plus.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group F (F1 salary = EUR 4.757,- paid 14 times a year, based on 38,5 hours per week). For this position we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your experience and qualifications, starting with a minimum gross salary of EUR 70.000 (annual, based on an All-in contract and bonus).

Welcome to Allianz

Multiple incidents and crisis situations and a continued growth of the threat landscape are challenges to the operational resilience of Allianz Group; the assessment and management of threats are crucial topics we focus on, when aiming at making Allianz a safer place.
The Group Protection and Resilience team within the Group center Digital resilience is committed to ensuring that Allianz Group is able to withstand and recover from disruptions to its business operations. For our team based in the headquarters in Munich, Germany, we are looking for an Incident and Crisis Management Expert who has a profound background in both domains and has strong project management skills. If you are ready to take over responsibility for the effective implementation and coordination of key aspects of the Group's Protection & Resilience Framework and be part of the team that prepares Allianz globally to withstand business disruptions and successfully manages global incidents and crisis, take up the challenge… We are looking forward to having you in our team.

- As the incident and crisis management expert in our Group Operational Resilience team, you own the end-to-end incident lifecycle — detection, classification against defined severity/major-incident criteria, cross-functional impact assessment, and coordinated response — ensuring a consistent, timely approach across the Group, including alignment with regulatory reporting obligations under DORA and much more including in particular ""non IT/IS incidents""

- Actively foster sharing and exchange of information on incident management within the Group, including conducting awareness activities and trainings, and maintain incident monitoring capabilities including interfaces to relevant early-warning and threat-intelligence sources
- Perform systematic monitoring by leading and executing OE review and self-assessment tasks
- Together with our crisis management experts, you enhance, shape and support the Protection & Resilience domain of Crisis Management and its implementation
- Support the OEs to improve their crisis readiness and maturity via their local crisis management programs, including conducting Crisis
- Unit exercises and trainings, crisis management community building and best practice sharing across the Allianz Group
- Working within and supporting the Allianz Group Crisis Unit & task forces in the event of a crisis event
- Participate in international projects related to Crisis Management and Protection & Resilience
- Act as back-up for other Protection & Resilience experts to mitigate key person risk

What you bring as Senior Incident- and crisis management Expert (m/f/d)

- 5 years of experience working/consulting experience in the Protection & Resilience domains (BCM, Incident Management, Protective Security Management)
- At least 3 years working/consulting experience in the domain of Incident-/ Crisis Management including hands-on experience managing incident coordination and response; Preferable background in Security, Risk or Operational Resilience
- Reliable, highly committed, precise working combined with analytical and conceptual skills.Capability to build collaborative working relationships and ability to work in virtual, international and complex team environments
- Strong communicator who is comfortable presenting and facilitating trainings in front of an audience
- Ability to work self-responsible and autonomously, also at times of high pressure
- International travel will be required
- Willingness to participate in the incident monitoring process, also beyond the usual working hours based on existing worker´s council agreement

Preferred qualifications:

- Topic supporting University degree (Master / PhD)
- Extraordinary skilled in usage of AI tools
- English skills on professional level
- Knowledge of industry and governmental standards in Incident-and Crisis management, preferred with Certification
- First leadership experience in (functional/supplier) leadership
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

- Health & Wellbeing: Company health insurance, sports and wellness programmes, and preventive health measures lay the foundation for your physical and mental well-being.
- Compensation: Collective agreement bonuses, a company pension plan, capital-forming benefits, and employee shares make our compensation package particularly attractive. On top of that, you directly participate in the company's success.
- Time & Flexibility: Our "New Work" model helps you achieve a better work-life balance. We work flexibly - hybrid, mobile, and on-site.
- Career Development: Together, we create a personal development plan and give you the opportunity to gain cross-functional and cross-border experience.

We are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical, to join the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is an individual contributor role. You report to the mechanical failure analysis lead. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. We need an electrical engineer with industry experience, not a new graduate, to identify and characterize electrical failures. You use a multimeter, an oscilloscope, and other basic electrical test equipment to confirm the symptom, isolate the fault, and support root cause with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality. What to Expect

We are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer to lead the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is the team lead. The electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician report to you. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. The role is hands-on. You own electromechanical failure analysis yourself, and you run the lab. You confirm and recreate failures, lead teardowns, and use optical microscopy, X-ray, and mechanical sample preparation to identify failure mechanisms. You report root cause and propose countermeasures with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and the other failure analysis engineers. The right person has several years of industry experience, is comfortable taking assemblies apart and putting them back together, and can connect what they see under a microscope or on an X-ray to how the part was designed and built. A materials science background is preferred.?

What You’ll Do

- Lead the failure analysis team and laboratory. Manage operations, lab workflows, equipment, and the two people who report to you: the electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician. 
- Drive failure analysis of electromechanical assemblies from the first report through root cause and countermeasure, including failure confirmation, recreation, and teardown inspection. 
- Use optical microscopes, 2D X-ray, and related inspection tools to characterize defects in mechanical and electromechanical hardware. 
- Prepare mechanical samples (sectioning, grinding, polishing) so failure interfaces can be inspected, and document what you find. 
- Disassemble and reassemble electromechanical assemblies while keeping the original form and function. 
- Design and run experiments to test a hypothesis, either yourself or with the technician.

- 3-5 years of industry experience in failure analysis, reliability, product development, or a related hands-on engineering role. This is not a new-graduate role. 
- Hands-on experience with optical microscopes, X-ray inspection, and teardown of mechanical or electromechanical assemblies. 
- Able to take an assembly down to its subcomponents and explain what the parts are and how they work.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.
We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. Therefore, applicants with severe disabilities are welcome and will be given special consideration if equally qualified.
We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.
Welcome to Allianz

Recurring crises and a rapidly evolving threat landscape continue to challenge the operational resilience of Allianz Group. Assessing and managing these threats is central to our mission of making Allianz a safer place. The Group Protection & Resilience team is committed to ensuring that Allianz Group can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptions to its operations.
For our team based at the headquarters in Munich, Germany, we are seeking a Protection and Resilience Governance Expert. The role focuses on governance, risk management, compliance, and control monitoring activities, working in close collaboration with P&R domain experts across the organization, the 1st and 2nd Lines of Defense, several Group functions, and OE Heads of P&R.
If you are ready to take ownership of the effective implementation and coordination of key elements of the Group's Protection & Resilience Framework, and to be part of a team that prepares Allianz globally to withstand disruptions and manage incidents and crises, we look forward to having you on our team.

What awaits you as Senior Protection and Resilience Governance Expert (m/f/d)

Through this role, you will have the main following responsibilities:

- 1.) Own and continuously evolve the global Group standard for Protection and Resilience (P&R) by defining, maintaining, and updating the P&R Framework, its Corporate Rules, Processes, and Controls together with Group domain experts — ensuring the standard remains fit for purpose as threats, regulatory expectations, and business needs evolve
- 2.) Act as the central governance authority steering the next generation of the Digital Resilience governance lifecycle, translating strategic direction into binding Group requirements and embedding regulatory compliance obligations groupwide, so that all Operating Entities (OEs) operate against one consistent, authoritative standard
- 3.) Direct groupwide regulatory compliance for P&R by leading the end-to-end review, updating, and Group vetting/approval process of P&R Corporate Rules, ensuring full alignment with the Digital Risk Management Framework and with applicable regulatory expectations across jurisdictions
- 4.) Steer OE Functional Monitoring through the design and execution of structured OE reviews and maturity assessments, evaluating threat readiness, identifying implementation gaps, and holding direct governance dialogues with OE Heads of P&R on progress against Group requirements
- 5.) Lead cross-functional coordination between Groupcenter and OE stakeholders, as well as 1st and 2nd Line of Defense functions, to ensure Group-wide alignment on requirements, resolve conflicting priorities, and safeguard consistent, compliant implementation across the organization
- 6.) Own the P&R Risk Management approach and Control Framework, working with Group domain experts to define, calibrate, and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that enable objective, data-driven governance steering and Group-wide performance transparency to senior stakeholders
- 7.) Govern reporting and documentation for P&R functional monitoring, ensuring outputs are audit-ready and defensible, and overseeing internal and external audit engagements — including evidence provision and Group-level tracking of remediation on audit findings through to closure
